d: After coming to the aid of a stranded roommate, Stephanie Brown's car is found abandoned on the interstate and her body is later discovered floating in an irrigation ditch, the victim of sexual assault and murder.

t: On the Case: One of Us
d: A young records clerk at the Seattle police department is murdered on her way to work her overnight shift. Can police find the evidence to catch the killer of one of their own?

t: On the Case: Heartbreak in the Heartland
d: A quiet Midwestern community is rocked by a gruesome triple homicide. The unspeakable tragedy robs one man of his mother, grandmother and 5 year old son.
A sexual predator viciously murders a 16 year old girl. Can investigators catch him before he kills again?

t: On the Case: A Drop of Blood
d: A single mother is murdered at work. Will a single drop of blood lead police to her killer?

t: On the Case: A Mother's Nightmare
d: A young boy is murdered in his bed in the middle of the night. Police suspect the child's mother. Over the next 9 years there will be accusations, a confession and a conviction but will justice be served?

t: On the Case: A Daughter's Quest
d: Victoria Baker was born with visual impairments and put up for adoption. When Victoria became an adult, she never imagined that her nearly 10-year-old quest for her biological mother would ultimately involve her in a heartbreaking murder investigation.

t: On the Case: Lying in Wait
d: A young mother goes out for a jog and runs into her killer. Does her teenage daughter hold the clue to solve the case?
Police suspect a mysterious double homicide is not what it appears to be.
When Rhonda Boggs is discovered murdered in her own kitchen, police get an important lead from the only witness to the crime, Rhonda's two year old daughter.

t: On the Case: Murder at Sunrise
d: A beautiful young mother is found murdered while walking her dogs. Investigators suspect her killer is someone she knew. Twenty-six years latter police make an arrest but is he the right man?

t: On the Case: Path of Tears
d: A 14-year-old girl is killed while walking her dog on a popular community bike trail.
After a young woman is viciously murdered, police launch a two-part investigation; one to find her killer and a second to identify his victim, "Precious" Jane Doe.

t: On the Case: No Body Two Crimes
d: A Wilmington, North Carolina, woman is reported missing after she fails to show up for her own birthday celebration. Police never imagined that their investigation would ultimately reveal a gruesome second crime.

t: On the Case: A Face with No Name
d: Police have DNA evidence and a videotape of their suspect, yet they still struggle to find a vicious killer.

t: On the Case: Footsteps in the Dark
d: A beautiful young woman's is murdered in a dark parking lot. Did she know her killer or was she the victim of a deadly predator?

t: On the Case: Vanished in the Night
d: When 20 year old Lynsie Ekelund suddenly goes missing in the dead of night, it leaves her mother scrambling for answers.

t: On the Case: Hidden by Lies
d: After a college student is found stabbed to death in her off-campus apartment, it may take a second murder to solve her case.

t: On the Case: Evidence Never Lies
d: A young woman is found drowned in her bathtub and the evidence at the crime scene indicates her killer was someone she knew and trusted.
